title: Minnesota Timberwolves Expected to Kick the Tires on Giannis Antetokounmpo Blockbuster Trade - NewsBreak
text:
By Debmallya Chakraborty ,
1 hours ago
Giannis Antetokounmpo (Image Credits: Imagn) The writing is now very much on the wall for the Milwaukee Bucks. After a long period of back-and-forth, it is almost certain that Giannis Antetokounmpo will now be leaving Milwaukee. Soon after the narrative was confirmed, there has been a flurry of speculations about what Antetokounmpo’s next destination could be.
Ever since the start of the season, smoke has been forming regarding the big man’s possible departure. Things took a more sinister turn as the Bucks failed to get their season going and faltered badly. And if that was not enough, Antetokounmpo’s recent injury came in as the final nail in the coffin.
Meanwhile, if a star of Antetokounmpo’s potential leaves Milwaukee, it is evident that multiple franchises will try to swoop in. Likewise, the Minnesota Timberwolves, too, are expected to make a definitive call.
“Anytime a player like Giannis Antetokoumpo is available, you have to put Timberwolves President of Basketball Operations Tim Connelly’s name in the running for a trade. Connelly has been one of the most aggressive front office leaders since he took the job in Minnesota. He has swung big deals for Rudy Gobert, Julius Randle and Donte DiVincenzo and his swap of D’Angelo Russell for Mike Conley and Nickeil Alexander-Walker helped catapult the Wolves into contender status,” said Jon Krawczynski.
Surely, it looks like things are getting heated up. And as the 31-year-old braces for the Bucks’ exit, Stephen A. Smith had some interesting thoughts to share .
Stephen A. Smith Wants Milwaukee Bucks To Trade Giannis Antetokounmpo Giannis Antetokounmpo (Image Credits: Imagn) Milwaukee remained rigid about letting its star player go. They are, in fact, still trying everything in their power to make the 31-year-old stay with the Bucks. However, according to Stephen A. Smith, it is now time to let the big man find his mojo for some new NBA franchise.
“ The Milwaukee Bucks need to wake the hell up and trade him. … Get him up out of there, he deserves better,” Smith said.
Thus, with many uncertainties surrounding Antetokounmpo, fans are eager to know when he will leave his current team.
